Response: WHATWG Fetch: the global response constructor Next.js returns
action: suss: code-unit kind for a server action
allPositional: suss: input-mapping kind, one input per declared parameter
index: Next.js: Pages Router index route basename
json: Next.js: NextResponse.json, and the Pages res method
page: Next.js: App Router page file basename
route: Next.js: App Router route handler file basename
serverAction: suss: the name an anonymous server action is counted under, serverAction#0
status: Next.js: NextResponse.json option key, and the Pages res method
proxy: Next.js: the file name version 16 gives the function it runs in front of every route
mts: language: TypeScript ES module file extension
mjs: language: JavaScript ES module file extension
sitemap: Next.js: metadata file under app, served as sitemap.xml
robots: Next.js: metadata file under app, served as robots.txt
icon: Next.js: metadata file under app, served as the app's icon
favicon: Next.js: metadata file under app, served as favicon.ico
public: Next.js: the directory whose files it serves at their own path
rewrites: Next.js: next.config key whose function returns the rewrite rules
redirects: Next.js: next.config key whose function returns the redirect rules
basePath: Next.js: next.config key that puts every route under a prefix
i18n: Next.js: next.config key that puts every route under a locale
pageExtensions: Next.js: next.config key that changes which files are pages and routes
exportPathMap: Next.js: next.config key that serves pages at paths of its own, in an export and under next dev
matcher: Next.js: middleware config property listing the paths it runs for
pathToRegexp: suss: served-beside pattern syntax tag, the path-to-regexp syntax Next.js matchers use
